entries.text: A hen's egg takes about 23 to 26 hours to pass from ovulation to laying.
entries.basis: Poultry Hub Australia, Reproductive system: egg formation time stated as 23 to 26 hours.

entries.text: The magnum adds roughly 40% of the albumen over about 3 hours.
entries.basis: Poultry Hub Australia: magnum secretes more than 40% of albumen; egg spends about 3 hours in this section.

entries.text: The shell gland, or uterus, holds the egg for 18 to 20 hours while the shell and about 40% of the albumen are added.
entries.basis: Poultry Hub Australia: uterus secretes about 40% of albumen and the shell; 18 to 20 hours.

entries.text: One egg uses about 2.5 g of calcium while a hen absorbs roughly 2.0 g per day from feed.
entries.basis: Poultry Hub Australia: approximately 2.5 g calcium per egg and about 2.0 g per day absorbed.

entries.text: The shortfall comes from medullary bone, a calcium store inside the long bones.
entries.basis: Poultry Hub Australia: medullary bone and skeleton supply the deficit, especially at night.

entries.text: Because shell calcification alone takes 18 to 20 hours, one egg per day is close to the ceiling of the cycle.
entries.basis: Derived from the 23 to 26 hour transit time and the 18 to 20 hour shell gland stage.

entries.text: A hen lays eggs without a rooster, and those eggs are unfertilised.
entries.basis: Poultry Hub Australia: ovulation is driven by the hen's own cycle; fertilisation needs sperm in the infundibulum.

entries.text: The sagittal hen cutaway, five-station oviduct and timer rings are original 3D illustrations, not dissection footage.
entries.basis: Built in the V6 SDK; no real tissue shown.

entries.text: Shell crystal growth is a seeded reaction-diffusion model; the on-screen speed is compressed, not real time.
entries.basis: Time-lapse compression for a 33 s Short; 18 to 20 hours mapped to about 4 s.

entries.text: The medullary-bone calcium dissolve is an illustrative model of a documented calcium transfer.
entries.basis: Mechanism is published; the visual is a model, not microscopy.

entries.text: The hero egg, albumen ribbons and closing loop frame are original parametric models.
entries.basis: No competitor frames, captions or audio reused.

entries.text: Exact timings vary by breed, age, diet and climate; on-screen numbers use published ranges.
entries.basis: Poultry Hub Australia notes percentages vary; single-point claims avoided.

entries.text: Outlier multiple came from a candidate with hidden subscriber count; virality is relative, not verified.
entries.basis: Official API run 46154175359 retained subscriber_count_known false.
